# prime-fluid

prime-rs: Fluid component (port of PrimeNG)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/fluid) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-fluid)

Fluid — port of `p-fluid` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Renders `<div class="p-fluid">` and provides descendants with the context `prime_rs_core::fluid`: `Button`, `InputText`,
`Textarea`, `InputNumber` and `Select` without an explicit `fluid` stretch to the full width. An explicit `fluid` (including `false`)
takes precedence over the context. `Fluid` has no styles of its own (there is no `@primeuix/styles/fluid` module).

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_fluid::Fluid;

let html = view! { <Fluid><input class="p-inputtext" /></Fluid> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains(r#"class="p-fluid""#));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-fluid = "0.1"
```

For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
